Name: Connections (example)
Sql:
SELECT a.MON$ATTACHMENT_ID AS "Attachment ID",
       a.MON$USER AS User_Name,
       a.MON$REMOTE_ADDRESS AS IP,
       a.MON$REMOTE_PROCESS AS Program,
       a.MON$TIMESTAMP AS Since
FROM MON$ATTACHMENTS a
WHERE a.MON$SYSTEM_FLAG = 0
ORDER BY a.MON$TIMESTAMP

Name: Open transactions (example)
Sql:
SELECT t.MON$ATTACHMENT_ID AS ATTACHMENT_ID,
       t.MON$TRANSACTION_ID AS Transaction_ID,
       t.MON$TIMESTAMP AS Since,
       a.MON$USER AS User_Name,
       a.MON$REMOTE_PROCESS AS Program
FROM MON$TRANSACTIONS t
JOIN MON$ATTACHMENTS a ON a.MON$ATTACHMENT_ID = t.MON$ATTACHMENT_ID
ORDER BY t.MON$TIMESTAMP
